THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SPIRE1-SILENT.0-0r.ch: So the Silent returns to the tower.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SPIRE1-SILENT.0-0r.ne: The Spire has not forgotten your blades.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SPIRE1-DEFECT.0-0r.ch: So the Defect powers up once more.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SPIRE1-DEFECT.0-0r.ne: The Spire has counted your orbs before.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SPIRE1-WATCHER.0-0r.c: So the Watcher walks the tower again.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SPIRE1-WATCHER.0-0r.n: The Spire has watched you watching it.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SPIRE1-WATCHER.0-atta: Then strike with a clear mind.
